# Patient RX System v3.0.3

## Configurable Patient Service Window

This patch changes the fixed 90-day patient service rule into a Backoffice setting while preserving 90 days as the default.

## What Changed

- Added **Backoffice > Settings > Service Window (Days)**.
- Administrators can configure a whole number from 1 through 365 days.
- The setting controls patient eligibility, service-date locks, RX workflow deadlines, arrival-date validation, Call Center queue eligibility, import validation, dashboard status, daily snapshots, and service-date cycle end dates.
- Call Center queue rows, metrics, eligible-since dates, and new-service-date input limits use the same configured value and server cutoff.
- Patient, RX, dashboard, and Backoffice displays now reflect the configured value.
- Changes are persisted in the existing settings file and written to the audit log.
- Added `npm run test:service-window` regression coverage.

## Compatibility and Data Impact

- Existing installations default to 90 days.
- No database migration or data reset is required.
- Existing patients, RX records, workflow history, service-date history, users, roles, and permissions are preserved.
- Changing the setting immediately changes runtime eligibility and deadline calculations. It does not rewrite historical service dates.
- Refresh browser pages after changing the setting so all displayed labels use the new value.

## Validation

- Configurable-window regression test.
- Workflow calendar-date regression test.
- Backoffice patient deletion regression test.
- Call Center queue regression test.
- JavaScript syntax and EJS template compilation checks.
- Production executable version check and release archive inspection.

## Deployment

1. Back up the production database and application folder.
2. Stop the RX application service.
3. Replace the approved application files from `server-update-3.0.3.zip` while preserving the production `.env`.
4. Start the service and confirm the administrator version endpoint reports `3.0.3`.
5. Open **Backoffice > Settings**, confirm the service window initially shows `90`, and save a temporary approved test value if production verification permits.
6. Refresh Patients, RX Records, Dashboard, and Call Center pages and confirm eligibility dates reflect the configured window.
7. Restore the approved production value after verification.
